description: Parse, validate and pretty-print a JSON string (strict RFC 8259). Indent with spaces or tabs, or minify with indent 0; optionally sort keys alphabetically at every level. Invalid JSON returns a specific error (trailing comma, unquoted key, single quotes, missing comma, comment, unclosed bracket) with its line and column. Valid JSON also lists warnings for duplicate keys and integers too large for a JavaScript number.

sortKeys.description: Sort object keys alphabetically at every level (default false)

name: format_json
